ideas.title: +1 Size Per Tumble
ideas.hook: Throw your ragdoll down a giant staircase. Every step you bounce off adds +1 to your body size, so the bigger you get, the harder you crash and the further you roll at the bottom.
core_loop: Dive off the top of the staircase
Each step hit gives +1 size and bones-broken cash
Your size at the bottom sets how far you slide into the payout zones
Spend cash on dive poses and bouncier suits, then rebirth onto a taller staircase
ideas.twist: Size is a double-edged stat: past a point you get stuck between the railings, so you buy 'squish' upgrades to keep tumbling.
retention: Rebirth onto taller staircases with a size cap reset
Offline cash from your best size
ideas.why_now: Physics Sim is the fastest-climbing subgenre at 2.28 momentum, up 0.88 this week (Ragdoll Reality 🩸 27.2K CCU, [🎃] Realistic Ragdoll Engine 🩸 17.1K). +1 stat per action is at 2.33 (+0.47) and the "+1 ___" title formula at 2.53 (+0.51), while Giant / huge jumped 0.60 to 1.54 behind [🎃] +1 Titan Evolution! and Durian Garden 🍈 (17.5K).
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games have no progression and +1 games have no physics; here the stat is your body size and every crash shows it.

ideas.title: Golf Your Friend to the Moon
ideas.hook: One player is the golfer, the other is the ball. Swing a giant club and launch your friend's ragdoll across low-gravity moon craters, then swap roles on the next hole.
core_loop: Pair up and pick roles: golfer or ball
Golfer aims and swings; the ball player steers mid-air with small jet puffs
Fewest strokes to the crater hole wins the round
Earn moon rocks for new clubs, suits and harder courses
ideas.twist: Low gravity means every shot bounces off craters for seconds, and the ball player can wreck a good shot on purpose for laughs or a trick-shot bonus.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is at 2.30 momentum, up 0.62 this week ([🎃] Throw Food For Animals 52.8K CCU, Cat Battles 🐾 11.3K). Physics Sim climbed 0.88 to 2.28, Space is up 0.39 to 1.48 ([👥 Multiplayer] Ragdoll Playground 5.1K, roll the world 🌎 3.9K) and Party / minigames rose 0.34 to 1.25.
ideas.differentiator: Golf games hit a ball; here the ball is your friend, which turns every shot into a two-player clip.

ideas.title: Car Price Duels
ideas.hook: Two players test-drive the same mystery car for 30 seconds, then each guesses its price. Closest guess keeps the car for their garage, and a perfect guess doubles it.
core_loop: Get matched 1v1 and spawn in a random car
Drive it around the test track to feel its speed and handling
Type your price guess before the timer ends
Closest guess wins the car into your garage index; sell spares for cash
ideas.twist: Test-drive laps give clues: hit top speed, drift, or crash-test the car to reveal hints like engine size and year.
retention: Fill the car index by brand
Showroom where friends can visit your garage
ideas.why_now: Vehicle Sim is at 1.53 momentum, up 0.25 ([🎃] Bike Universe 21.2K CCU, Realistic Car Destruction 8.8K) and Vehicles is up 0.32 to 1.66. Quiz / guess rose 0.68 to 1.67 but leans on one breakout (Thai Quiz Duels 15.6K holds most of its players), so it is only the side twist here.
ideas.differentiator: Car games make you grind for cars; here you win them by knowing them, and the test drive is the clue.

ideas.title: Don't Drop the Money
ideas.hook: One briefcase of cash in the arena, and it grows by $1,000 every second someone holds it. Everyone else is trying to tackle you and send your ragdoll flying so it drops.
core_loop: Round starts with one briefcase in the middle
Grab it and run; the payout grows while you hold it
Other players dive and tackle to knock it loose
Whoever holds it at the bell banks the pot
ideas.twist: The briefcase gets heavier as it grows, so the richest holder is also the slowest; smart players drop it on purpose near a jump pad.
ideas.why_now: Money / rich is the top rising theme at 2.14 momentum, up 0.36 ([🎃]Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 36.2K CCU, [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It! 28.6K). Party / minigames is up 0.34 to 1.25, and Physics Sim tackle-and-ragdoll games climbed 0.88 to 2.28 (Ragdoll Reality 🩸 27.2K).
inspired_by: [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: It is keep-away, not hot potato: you want the prize, and its weight is the built-in comeback rule.

ideas.title: Drive the Cash Truck
ideas.hook: Drive an open cash truck down a long road full of potholes, ramps and robbers. Every bump spills real bills out the back, and you only keep what is still in the truck at the bank.
core_loop: Load cash at the vault
Drive the route; bumps and crashes spill bills behind you
Deliver to the bank and keep what is left
Upgrade the truck (straps, suspension, armor) and your vault to carry bigger loads
ideas.twist: Spilled cash stays on the road, so other players can drive behind you and scoop it up, or drop off to escort you.
retention: Longer, harder routes unlocked by vault level
ideas.why_now: Money / rich is at 2.14 momentum (+0.36 this week, Durian Garden 🍈 17.5K CCU) and Vehicles at 1.66 (+0.32, [🎃] Bike For Egg! 27.3K). Vehicle Sim is up 0.25 to 1.53 behind Realistic Car Destruction (8.8K), and Realistic art is rising at 1.62 with 26 new games.
ideas.differentiator: Physics turns your score into something you can see falling out of the truck, and every bill is loot for someone else.

ideas.title: Ragdoll Knight Games
ideas.hook: A medieval tournament of floppy knights: log toss, ram charge, moat jump and the trebuchet ride. Each event is a short physics round, and the crowd's gold goes to the best wipeout.
core_loop: Join a 10-knight tournament
Play 4 random events, each 60-90 seconds
Points for winning and for the crowd-voted best fail
Spend gold on armor sets that change your physics (heavy, bouncy, spiky)
ideas.twist: Armor weight really changes how your ragdoll moves, so picking the right set for each event is the strategy.
ideas.why_now: Physics Sim is up 0.88 this week to 2.28 (Ragdoll Reality 🩸 27.2K CCU, [🎃] Realistic Ragdoll Engine 🩸 17.1K) and Hit / swing / launch up 0.62 to 2.30. Party / minigames rose 0.34 to 1.25 and Fantasy / medieval holds steady at 1.41 with 13 new games ([👥 Multiplayer] Ragdoll Playground 5.1K).
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games are open sandboxes; this gives the physics a goal, a crowd and short rounds that are easy to clip.

ideas.title: +1 Snowball Size
ideas.hook: Roll a snowball and every step adds +1 to its size. When it is big enough, shove it off the ski jump and see how much of the frozen town below it flattens.
core_loop: Roll your snowball around the slope; +1 size per step
Push it off the ski jump
Distance and buildings flattened pay out ice gems
Buy gloves, slopes and rebirth for bigger multipliers
ideas.twist: Snowballs melt on sunny patches, so routes through shade matter and fire zones in later worlds shrink you fast.
retention: Offline gems from your best size
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is at 2.33 momentum (+0.47 this week, [🎃] +1 Venom Evolution 19.4K CCU, [🎃] +1 Stone Skipping 9.2K) and the "+1 ___" formula at 2.53 (+0.51). Hit / swing / launch adds 0.62 to 2.30, and Ice / fire / elements holds at 1.33 with 11 new games (Firefighting Sim 🚒 6.8K).
ideas.differentiator: The stat is a physical ball you build and then throw, so the payoff is a big crash, not just a number.

ideas.title: Hero Crash Landing
ideas.hook: You are a new hero who can fly but cannot land. Launch off the hero tower, fly across the city, and crash into it: the bigger the crater, the more fame you earn.
core_loop: Launch from the hero tower
Steer in the air to pick a landing spot
Crash; crater size and things smashed pay fame
Spend fame on capes and powers (dive, spin, ground pound) that boost crashes
ideas.twist: Civilians you land near cheer or boo; landing on villains' cars gives bonus fame while hitting the bakery costs you.
retention: New city districts by fame level
ideas.why_now: Physics Sim is up 0.88 to 2.28 (Ragdoll Reality 🩸 27.2K CCU, Crazy Diver 6.5K) and Hit / swing / launch up 0.62 to 2.30 ([🎃] Throw Food For Animals 52.8K). Superheroes / powers holds at 1.38 with 7 new games led by Superhero Arena (9.6K).
ideas.differentiator: Hero games are about fighting; this is about the landing, which is the funniest part of flying.

ideas.title: Splat Paint on the Giant
ideas.hook: A huge blank statue stands in the middle of the map. Dip your ragdoll in paint, launch from a slingshot and splat onto it. Every patch you cover earns cash for your studio.
core_loop: Pick paint colours in your studio
Launch your paint-covered ragdoll at the giant
Covered area pays cash; matching the daily design pays more
Upgrade slingshots, paint buckets and studio machines
ideas.twist: Each day the giant gets a target design (a face, a flag), and the whole server works on it together; finishing it unlocks a bigger giant.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 1.87 momentum with 13 new games (Backseat Rally 15.6K CCU, [🎃] Kukirin Life [Testing] 12.5K), down 0.17 so this pairs it with Hit / swing / launch, up 0.62 to 2.30. Giant / huge jumped 0.60 to 1.54 (Durian Garden 🍈 17.5K) and Tycoon / base building stays at 1.42 with 65 new games.
ideas.differentiator: Painting games are solo and careful; here you paint by crashing into a shared giant, so a server builds one picture together.

ideas.title: Build a Stunt Park
ideas.hook: Build ramps, loops and crash walls on your plot, then let visitors drive through it. Every flip and wreck on your park earns tickets, and you can ride it too.
core_loop: Place ramps, loops and obstacles on your plot
Visitors (players and NPCs) drive and crash through it
Stunts and crashes earn tickets for the owner
Unlock bigger pieces, cars and park zones
ideas.twist: Other players rate your park after each run, and top-rated parks get a portal in the hub so everyone visits them.
ideas.why_now: Vehicle Sim is up 0.25 to 1.53 ([🎃] Bike Universe 21.2K CCU, Realistic Car Destruction 8.8K) and Vehicles up 0.32 to 1.66 ([🎃] Bike For Egg! 27.3K). Tycoon / base building has 65 new games at 1.42, and Physics Sim crashes are up 0.88 to 2.28.
ideas.differentiator: Stunt games give you a fixed map; here players build the map and earn when others crash on it.
